description: Executable coverage map for QudJP C# localization discovery, closure gates, and runtime verification boundaries.

true_untranslated_zero_definition.statement: QudJP can implement static and owner-route closure slices without fresh runtime evidence, but QudJP can claim true untranslated-zero only when every player-visible text surface is covered by an owner-route proof, closed by a tracked inventory gate, covered by asset validators for fixed data, or explicitly assigned to a runtime closeout gate.
required_proofs: Tracked static inventories must have zero owner-action queue rows or a reviewed closure overlay for every remaining row.
Route-family surfaces must name the owner route, focused tests, and the next inventory, owner-route test, closure overlay, or runtime evidence needed before broad closure.
Localization assets must pass deterministic validators for schema, token parity, and placeholder/markup preservation.

Fresh runtime evidence is required for runtime-reliant closeout decisions and before making a project-wide true untranslated-zero claim; it is not a prerequisite for static inventory, owner-route, or asset-validator implementation slices.
disallowed_proofs: sink-observed translation or renderer output alone is not owner-route coverage.
Visible fallback output, including exact dictionary hits on dynamic text, is not coverage unless the route is proven fixed-leaf safe.
Legacy inventories and stale notes are not source-of-truth closure evidence.

surfaces.label: Static C# producer sinks: EmitMessage, Popup.Show*, AddPlayerMessage
surfaces.closure_owner: static producer closure overlay and owner-action queue
known_limits: Covers only EmitMessage, Popup.Show*, and AddPlayerMessage producer families.
Current-repo owner coverage is represented by a separate closure overlay, not by the raw inventory alone.
The owner action queue is class-file based for this scanner scope; it does not cover SetText or display-name construction.
next_actions: Use just static-producer-owner-queue to choose the next decompiled C# source file and producer method.
Expand covered owner-family registry as owner patch tests land.
Keep owner_action_queue as the implementation queue for this scanner scope.

surfaces.label: Roslyn player-visible text construction surfaces and owner candidates
target_surfaces: Qud/XRL UI direct text owner candidates
known_limits: The full generated inventory is intentionally not committed.
Generic Attribute, Initializer, OtherInvocation, Other, Assignment, Return, StringBuilderAppend, StringFormat, and ReplaceChain rows are not localization surfaces by themselves.
SetText and direct text assignment are valuable only after owner class or method context proves player visibility.
next_actions: Use just text-construction-surface-queue to inspect only player-visible APIs and likely owner candidates.
Promote candidate-only rows only when a visible owner route or runtime evidence proves player exposure.
Add surface-specific closure overlays before counting these families as implemented.

surfaces.label: Issue #809 conversation, quest body, cooking, active-effect, and status text audit
surfaces.closure_owner: Issue #809 cross-surface audit ledger and existing surface-specific owner lanes
known_limits: This audit reconciles existing lanes; it is not a new claim of true untranslated-zero coverage.
Static producer queue zero does not close conversation, quest body, cooking effect, active-effect, or status UI routes.
quest titles are intentionally excluded from issue #809 translation targets; quest body, journal, handler, step, and reward text remain separately auditable.
Conversation and hidden-conversation authored XML text, runtime expansion terms, and choice part names are tracked in docs/issue-809-authored-text-inventory.json.
DynamicQuestRewardElement_ChoiceFromPopulation reward options have an owner-route emitted-shape test for generated display names, comma-separated option parts, and &WxN quantity suffixes.

Cooking/meal FoodConsumptionFrame and player-status FoodWater shapes have owner-route emitted-shape tests; active-effect/status UI rows have owner-route tests, but true untranslated-zero still requires fresh runtime evidence.
next_actions: Use the issue #809 authored-text inventory to pick specific authored conversation or quest rows before implementation.
Keep authored data-source fixes separate from runtime owner-route fixes.
Fetch fresh runtime Player.log evidence only when deciding whether a candidate shape is live-visible or sink-only.

surfaces.label: Annals and HistorySpice generated narrative patterns
surfaces.closure_owner: Annals and HistorySpice generated narrative pattern inventory
known_limits: Generated narrative coverage is pattern-based and still has pending candidates.
HistorySpice component composition and generated names can surface outside fixed Annals patterns.
next_actions: Keep generated narrative candidates as component/pattern translators, not broad exact leaves.
Promote pending candidates only with tests that cover generated variants.

surfaces.label: Activated ability and generated ability display names
surfaces.closure_owner: activated ability display-name scanner and route tests
known_limits: The scanner output is not tracked as a repo artifact.
Generated display-name-source and dynamic-composition rows require owner/generator translation, not exact leaves.
next_actions: Add a tracked or reproducible summary for real decompiled-source runs.
Connect dynamic-composition rows to owner closure tests.

surfaces.label: Procedural cooking effect descriptions and details
surfaces.closure_owner: procedural cooking domain report and focused owner tests

Only audited cooking producer slices should be considered closed.
next_actions: Convert the cooking report into an executable scanner or domain closure registry if more slices are needed.

Runtime-generated title, liquid/container, and blueprint fallback names still require route-family work.

Add closure rows for generated name families as they are owner-tested.

surfaces.label: Conversation display text, simple/question templates, and pronoun exchange
surfaces.closure_owner: ConversationDisplayTextPatch plus conversation data/template owner tests
known_limits: Conversation data/templates do not have a complete tracked inventory.
Conversation routes may include authored XML/data and runtime-composed text.
Static producer queue zero does not close conversation choice tags or body append/replace routes.
Issue-719 conversation text-construction lane has 0 action_required entries, with residual partial/runtime rows delegated to display-name, data-source, Kith-and-Kin, book, or runtime evidence routes.
next_actions: Keep the conversation_routes text-construction lane separate from popup/message static producer closure.
Add a conversation-data inventory or classify conversation assets separately from runtime templates.

surfaces.label: Journal, map notes, accomplishments, notifications, quest log, and generated quest titles
surfaces.closure_owner: journal and quest owner route tests pending generated-title inventory
known_limits: No full static inventory covers generated quest title construction.
Journal surfaces can expose generated names that also need display-name owner coverage.
next_actions: Inventory generated quest title templates and connect them to journal/quest owner tests.

surfaces.label: Character generation UI, subtype selection, chrome, attributes, and structured text

known_limits: CharGen has strong route tests but no complete source inventory for all UI text-producing controls.

surfaces.label: Screen-specific UI rows and bindings: inventory, equipment, trade, skills, factions, options, saves, books, world map

surfaces.label: HUD, player status bar, ability bar, selected ability, target text, and active effects

surfaces.label: Localization XML, JSON dictionaries, scoped dictionaries, token parity, glossary and corpus assets
known_limits: Asset validators do not prove dynamic producer ownership.
Dictionary coverage is not accepted for procedural or sink-observed text unless the route is proven fixed-leaf safe.
next_actions: Keep asset validation separate from producer closure queues.

surfaces.label: Runtime untranslated triage, final output observability, sink observation, and L3 evidence
known_limits: Runtime evidence is not primary discovery for statically inventoried surfaces.
Runtime-only rows are priority and verification evidence, not automatic dictionary candidates.
next_actions: Use runtime-only rows to identify missing inventory surfaces or route-proof gaps.

surfaces.label: UITextSkin, renderer conversion, sink observation, color restoration, and final display boundaries
surfaces.closure_owner: renderer and sink boundary observation tests
known_limits: Sink-wide translation is intentionally not an owner route.
Renderer-owned conversion after QudJP hands text off cannot be closed by producer inventory alone.
next_actions: Keep sink observations as route-gap evidence and promote safe ownership upstream.

next_actions: Tie generated village/zone name families to Annals and display-name inventories.
